contentBlocks.text: How to Check Your SASSA Grant Status
You can check your SASSA grant application or payment status using any of these methods.
This guide is for SASSA grant applicants and beneficiaries who want to check their application or payment status using online, WhatsApp, USSD, or in-person methods.
Visit srd.sassa.gov.za. Enter your ID number and the phone number used during application. You will receive an OTP via SMS to access your status dashboard.
Save 082 046 8553 to your phone. Send 'SASSA' to start. Follow the prompts to check your balance, payment date, or application status. Free on most networks.
Dial *134*7737# on your mobile phone. Follow the menu to check your grant status. Standard network rates apply.
Bring your ID to any SASSA local office. A clerk can look up your status and provide a printout if needed.
